text: The filter dropmarker test waits a frame before Enter and Space, observes shown/hidden popup events around Escape and checks focus returns to the invoking button. The added Assert.ok(true) lines are progress messages; the waits and focus equality assertions establish useful behavior. Preserve those real checks when simplifying the test. This source pattern does not prove keyboard or assistive-technology behavior on every platform. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.
title: Wait for popup state and focus after keyboard actions
